name: Project Control Desk
description: Turns an approved project baseline and current evidence into critical-path visibility, accountable next actions, and a factual stakeholder update.

intake.description: The approved baseline, current dated status, owners, dependencies, changes, blockers, and delivery constraints. An undocumented status remains unverified.

roles.title: Intake
roles.goal: Normalize baseline and current dates, milestones, owners, dependencies, changes, status evidence, and unknowns without silently rewriting the approved plan.

roles.title: Critical Path Analyst
roles.goal: Identify the evidence-backed critical path, schedule variance, blocked dependencies, decision deadlines, delivery risks, and the smallest accountable recovery actions.

roles.title: Stakeholder Update Writer
roles.goal: Draft a concise factual update separating completed, in-progress, blocked, changed, and unverified work. Name owners and dates without sending or promising outcomes.

output_contract.description: A source-backed project-control packet with accountable next actions and a draft update for human review.
